biological_replicate: Through the MRC Edinburgh sudden death brain bank, we were able to access samples from 33 brain tissue donors
experimental_design: pooled 8-plex TMT analysis comparing disease status, APOE genotype, and brain region
With this study design incorporating disease, brain region, and APOE genotype, it is possible to design a series of comparisons
factor_value: disease status (AD, control), APOE genotype (3/3, 3/4), brain region (BA41/42, BA17)
25 μg of each of the 33 subjects were pooled according to disease status, APOE genotype (3/3 or 3/4) and brain region (BA41/42 or BA17)
number_of_fractions: The total number of fractions concatenated was set to 20 by non-contiguous pooling
number_of_biological_replicates: We examined brain tissue from 33 subjects (7–10 per group)
number_of_samples: We performed a complex 8-plex TMT LC-MS/MS analysis
